scope: optional persistent cache for the existing exact categorical symbol histogram

checks.parity: uncached, cold and warm evaluations yield identical CSV; entropy and per-symbol counts share one cached histogram per snapshot
checks.identity: changing symbols, their order, encoding or coverage produces a miss; independent collisions cannot reuse an entry with different exact input bytes
checks.recovery: corrupt and incomplete entries rebuild, concurrent writers yield a valid entry, and unavailable storage still returns the exact diagnostic
checks.bounds: 64 replaceable slots of at most 256 KiB each; oversize entries compute without persistence; unrelated metric selection creates no entries
checks.install: repeat the checks in the release, sanitizer, and substrate-free matrix on all three supported hosts

limits: local derived-data cache only. No estimator results, scientific cache keys, timing claims or calibration.
